gloss: demotion, transfer to a less important position

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {左遷|させん}しませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {左遷|させん}していなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {左遷|させん}していませんでした

definitions.explanation: Being transferred to a less important or desirable position as a form of punishment or due to failure; a career setback disguised as a transfer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支店|してん}→支店：03185_shiten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{左遷|させん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was demoted to a regional branch.

examples.japanese: {左遷|させん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{恐|おそ}れて→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逆|さか}らえない→逆らう：02106_sakarau⟧。
examples.english: I can't go against my boss for fear of being demoted.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{閑職|かんしょく}→閑職：15211_kanshoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{左遷|させん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That failure resulted in being relegated to a dead-end position.

examples.japanese: {左遷|させん}⟦されても→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{腐|くさ}らずに→腐る：02049_kusaru⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}った→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: Even after being demoted, he kept working hard without becoming bitter.

notes:
{左遷|させん} refers to a career demotion typically involving transfer to a less desirable post.

ETYMOLOGY:
The kanji ⟦{左|さ}→左：00628_hidari⟧ (left) + ⟦{遷|せん}→遷：noentry⟧ (transfer) comes from ancient China, where the left side was considered inferior to the right. Being moved "to the left" meant a demotion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {左遷|させん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ - to be demoted
- {左遷|させん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}らう→食らう：noentry⟧ - to suffer a demotion
- ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{左遷|させん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ - to be banished to the provinces

USAGE:
In Japanese corporate culture, outright firing is rare. Instead, unwanted employees may be {左遷|させん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ to unimportant positions until they quit voluntarily. Being transferred to a distant branch office is a common form.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {左遷|させん} vs. ⟦{降格|こうかく}→降格：04688_koukaku⟧: {左遷|させん} involves transfer; ⟦{降格|こうかく}→降格：04688_koukaku⟧ is a direct rank reduction
- {左遷|させん} vs. ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧: ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧ is neutral transfer; {左遷|させん} implies punishment
